consumer: The pickup path's fit gate calling Character::can_pick_weight(item), asking the yes/no question 'can this character take on this item's weight given what they already carry?'
scope: only the character's own carried weight plus the single candidate item (on-person carry), not nearby/reachable inventory
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::can_pick_weight -- its body returns a bool comparing weight_carried()+weight against capacity (weight_capacity()*4 in the default unsafe branch, weight_capacity() when safe), i.e. the engine-computed pickup-fit predicate; weight_capacity() (Excerpt 1) is only an input and the scalar export (Excerpt 2) is unrelated
divergence: A character whose weight_carried()+item.weight() lands strictly between weight_capacity() and weight_capacity()*4: the real predicate (default unsafe) returns true, but a re-derivation comparing only against bare weight_capacity() returns false -- exposing the wrong authority
